esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; D1.DIN → D25 (GPIO25). Added a separate 5 V supply for 5V (it needs 4.5–5.3 V and up to 15.4 A, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. Added the ws2812b_16x16.py driver written from the datasheet.
The matrix starts dark, then lights a red diagonal on blue and reports the bytes sent: passes
